name: tasknotes-macos
description: Native macOS Facet app and shared Apple SwiftUI/SQLite3 sync libraries.

scripts.lint: if [ -d /Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer ]; then export DEVELOPER_DIR="${DEVELOPER_DIR:-/Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer}"; fi; swiftlint lint --strict --quiet && ./ci/no-suppressions.sh
scripts.mac:snapshots: bun run mac:preflight && DEVELOPER_DIR="${DEVELOPER_DIR:-/Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer}" swift test --filter TaskNotesMacTests
scripts.mac:format: DEVELOPER_DIR="${DEVELOPER_DIR:-/Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer}" xcrun swift-format format --in-place --parallel --recursive Sources Tests App UITests Package.swift
scripts.mac:format:check: DEVELOPER_DIR="${DEVELOPER_DIR:-/Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer}" xcrun swift-format lint --strict --parallel --recursive Sources Tests App UITests Package.swift
scripts.mac:analyze: DEVELOPER_DIR="${DEVELOPER_DIR:-/Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer}" xcodebuild -project TaskNotes.xcodeproj -scheme TaskNotes -configuration Debug -derivedDataPath .build/xcode clean build > .build/xcodebuild.log && swiftlint analyze --strict --quiet --config .swiftlint-analyzer.yml --compiler-log-path .build/xcodebuild.log
scripts.mac:smoke: bun run mac:app:release && bun run scripts/verify-launch.ts
scripts.mac:e2e: bun run mac:generate && bun run scripts/run-ui-tests.ts
scripts.mac:verify: bun run mac:generate && bun run mac:build && bun run mac:test && bun run lint && bun run mac:format:check && bun run mac:app && bun run mac:smoke
